mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.2% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which may indicate an impending economic slowdown and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE crosses 4.2%, the subsequent 5-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both > 0.5% drop in 2 months) does not lead to negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of slowing industrial production (INDPRO growth rate below 1.5% annually), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO growth is below 1.5% annually, the 20-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO growth rate is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, which may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, the subsequent 5-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is above 100k (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (GDP growth above 2.0% annually), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns due to overvaluation and the risk of policy tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of GDP growth above 2.0% annually, the 20-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 growth rate is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain, which may lead to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 105.0, the subsequent 5-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
